github.copilot.chat.testGeneration.instr.text: Add or update focused tests for changed behavior. Prefer test-first development and Arrange-Act-Assert structure where practical. Follow the project's existing test and coverage conventions.

github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Use conventional commit format: <type>: <description>. Types: feat, fix, refactor, docs, test, chore, perf, ci. Keep the subject concise and focus on why the change was made.
